properties.name: dismissLayer
properties.description:
Render the full-viewport dismiss layer under the panel while open.
Defaults to `true`. Set to `false` for triggers that must stay
clickable while open (e.g. an input-style combobox trigger);
outside pointer dismissal still applies via `allowClickOutside`.

properties.name: focusTrap
properties.description: Trap Tab focus inside the panel while open. Defaults to `true`.

properties.name: lockScroll
properties.description: Lock document scrolling while the panel is open. Defaults to `true`.

properties.name: element
properties.description:
Bindable reference to the rendered DOM element. Type is the union of
the two possible element types -- narrow at the use site:

properties.name: unstyled
properties.description: Skip the variant/size base classes and render with `class` alone.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Controlled visual state. Loading remains focusable and refuses activation.

properties.name: onclick
properties.type: (((event: MouseEvent) => void) & MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>) | (((event: MouseEvent) => void) & MouseEventHandler<HTMLAnchorElement>) | undefined
